name: elev_mean_10m
meaning: Mean elevation in the 20 m cell. From 1 m lidar degraded to 10 m. Also used by the elevation term in the model output.

name: elev_min_10m
meaning: Lowest elevation in the 20 m cell, same source.

name: microrelief_10m
meaning: Elevation range (max minus min) inside the 20 m cell.

name: roughness_10m
meaning: Standard deviation of elevation inside the 20 m cell.

name: slope_10m
meaning: Slope from the degraded DEM.

name: basin_facc
meaning: Flow accumulation: how many cells drain into this one. Routed over the whole basin, not the tile.

name: basin_hand
meaning: Height above the nearest drainage.

name: basin_slope
meaning: Slope from the basin-wide 10 m DEM.

name: basin_spi
meaning: Stream power index.

name: basin_twi
meaning: Topographic wetness index.

name: rain_1h_peak
meaning: MRMS radar rain over the 1 hour ending at the hour the flood report starts. The name says peak, but it is that single hour, not a maximum over a window.

name: rain_24h
meaning: MRMS radar rain over the 24 hours ending at that same hour.

name: rain_ante48h
meaning: MRMS 24 hour total ending 48 hours before the report hour.

name: rain_ante72h
meaning: MRMS 24 hour total ending 72 hours before the report hour.

name: soil_bd
meaning: POLARIS bulk density.

name: soil_clay
meaning: POLARIS clay content.

name: soil_ksat
meaning: POLARIS saturated hydraulic conductivity: how fast water can soak in. Stored as a log, so negative values are normal.

name: soil_sand
meaning: POLARIS sand content.

name: lc_class
meaning: ESA WorldCover class code. A category, not a quantity: 10 tree, 20 shrub, 30 grass, 40 crop, 50 built, 60 bare, 70 snow, 80 water, 90 wetland, 95 mangrove, 100 moss.

name: lc_cropland
meaning: 1 where lc_class is 40.

name: lc_water
meaning: 1 where lc_class is 80.

name: catchment_area_km2
meaning: Area that drains into this pixel. Routed at 100 m.

name: rain_1h_over_ksat_upstream_mean
meaning: Mean over the catchment of 1 hour rain divided by ksat.

name: rain_1h_upstream_depth_mm
meaning: Mean 1 hour rain depth over the catchment.

name: rain_1h_upstream_vol_m3
meaning: Total 1 hour rain volume falling on the catchment.

name: rain_24h_upstream_depth_mm
meaning: Mean 24 hour rain depth over the catchment.

name: rain_24h_upstream_vol_m3
meaning: Total 24 hour rain volume falling on the catchment.

name: rain_cover_frac
meaning: Share of the catchment the radar actually saw. Exactly 1.0 on every valid pixel, so it carries no information.

name: runoff_1h_upstream_depth_mm
meaning: Routed infiltration-excess runoff, mean depth. Runoff per cell is max(0, rain_1h - ksat).

name: runoff_1h_upstream_vol_m3
meaning: Routed infiltration-excess runoff, total volume.
